entries.title: Genesis 36:1
segments:
Generations of Esau; a notice of his descendants. 
 
  Edom;

entries.title: Genesis 36:2
segments: In the different accounts his wives and their parents are called by different names, more than one name being often applied to the same person.

entries.title: Genesis 36:7
segments:
Could not bear them; they needed more pasturage for their flocks. 
 
In this world, as to temporal things, God treats the righteous and the wicked in many respects alike.  He makes his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sends his rain on the just and on the unjust.  But in the future world, each will receive according to his works.

entries.title: Genesis 36:20
segments: Sons of Seir; these were the former inhabitants, called Horites.

entries.title: Genesis 36:24
segments: The mules; many prefer to render, the "warm springs," perhaps those of Callirrhoe, on the east side of the Dead sea.

entries.title: Genesis 36:43
segments: Enough of the history of Esau's descendants is given in the Bible to show that the promises of God concerning him were accomplished.
